title: Formal learning hours per employee fell by more than half in four years, then edged up
subtitle: Average formal learning hours used per employee a year, organisations in ATD's State of the Industry surveys

annotations.text: 16.7, the first rise in five years

notes: Each year is a separate group of organisations (539 reported 2024 data; 340 took part in the 2026 report on 2025), not the same organisations tracked over time.
Formal learning only: on-the-job and informal learning are not counted.
